marketSummary: Indian benchmark indices suffered their steepest single-session drop in over ten weeks on September 24, 2026. The Nifty 50 tumbled 383.70 points (-1.64%) to settle at 23,063.10, while the BSE Sensex sank 1,247.71 points (-1.67%) to 73,580.54, driven by a spike in Brent crude above $105/bbl, surging US 10-year Treasury yields to 5.11%, and broad selling across financials and insurance names. India VIX surged over 22%. In contrast, exchange debutant NSE made its BSE listing at ₹1,800 (+0.84% premium) and rallied towards ₹1,817–1,845 in secondary trading.

news.headline: Info Edge tumbles 7% as PB Fintech crash wipes ₹1,809 crore off value of 6.5% holding
news.summary: Shares of Info Edge (India) tumbled nearly 7% to ₹1,209 on the NSE following the steep sell-off in PB Fintech. Info Edge holds a 6.5% equity stake (2.99 crore shares) in the insurtech major, translating into an immediate mark-to-market loss of over ₹1,808 crore.
news.impact: Downside gap-and-go pattern damages prior base accumulation; swing traders should watch for potential retests of prior quarterly support levels.

news.headline: Nifty slides below 23,100 and Sensex sheds 1,248 points amid crude spike and surging bond yields
news.summary: The Nifty 50 dropped 1.64% to settle at 23,063.10 and Sensex plunged 1,247.71 points to 73,580.54, marking their steepest single-session tumble in 10 weeks. The selloff was driven by Brent crude jumping above $105/bbl, US 10-year Treasury yields pushing to 5.11%, and India VIX surging over 22%.
news.impact: Triggers breakdown below consolidation ranges; swing traders should tighten stop-losses and avoid buying opening gaps until 23,000 support holds.

news.headline: PB Fintech crashes 34% hitting lower circuit after IRDAI proposes distribution commission overhaul
news.summary: PB Fintech shares plummeted over 32-34% to ₹1,244.50 on September 24, recording the stock's worst single-session plunge. The crash followed IRDAI's draft consultation proposing strict caps on commissions paid to distributors and banning dark patterns on aggregator platforms.
news.impact: Invalidates long-term basing structures overnight with severe institutional liquidation; strictly avoid bottom-fishing until regulatory clarity emerges.

news.headline: BEL inks emerging tech MoU with NIRNAYA Systems following ₹648 crore fresh defence contract inflows
news.summary: Bharat Electronics signed an MoU on September 22-24 with NIRNAYA Systems to pursue opportunities in AI/ML, cybersecurity, and data center platforms. This builds on BEL's recent disclosure of ₹648 crore in order wins across laser IR jammers, communication gear, and AI applications.
news.impact: Consistent order wins offer downside cushion, keeping price action coiled near base pivot levels despite general market weakness.

news.headline: NSE marks public market debut on BSE at ₹1,800; shares advance to ₹1,817 in initial trade
news.summary: The National Stock Exchange of India (NSE) debuted on the BSE on September 24 at ₹1,800 per share (+0.84% premium over the ₹1,785 issue price) and rose towards ₹1,817, valuing the exchange at ₹4.49 lakh crore ($46 billion). The ₹22,562 crore pure-OFS IPO was subscribed 5.71 times.
news.impact: Benchmark liquidity event that establishes a direct valuation multiple peer for BSE; watch for volatility contraction in domestic exchange operators.

news.headline: HAL concludes Tejas Mk-1 contract with twin-seater delivery; LCA Mk-1A flight testing on track
news.summary: HAL formally handed over the final two Tejas Mk-1 FOC trainers to the IAF on September 18, closing its original 40-jet contract. Chairman & MD Ravi K stated that last-mile radar and weapons integration tests are being resolved, aiming for initial LCA Mk-1A deliveries to commence by late 2026.
news.impact: Clearing legacy delivery milestones establishes a catalyst runway for Mk-1A execution; watch for base consolidation near major moving averages.

news.headline: CG Power engages institutional investors as Sanand OSAT chip facility reaches commercial operations
news.summary: CG Power scheduled one-on-one institutional meetings on September 24 following disclosures that its subsidiary CG Semi has commenced commercial operations at the ₹7,600 crore Sanand OSAT facility. This pairs with a 45% YoY surge in its power systems order backlog to ₹17,333 crore.
news.impact: High-volume defense of the ₹880–₹900 zone; holds a promising multi-week consolidation base if broader market pressures stabilize.

news.headline: Cochin Shipyard tumbles 12% over two sessions after management trims EBITDA margin guidance
news.summary: Cochin Shipyard fell over 12% across two sessions after management indicated in an analyst conference call that it is guiding for an EBITDA margin of 14% over the next two fiscal years, significantly down from 24% in FY26, despite a strong ₹22,000 crore order book and JV with Drydocks World.
news.impact: Margin downgrade triggers institutional derating, breaking weekly support lines and halting any near-term cup-and-handle or flag development.

news.headline: Allied Blenders and Carborundum Universal hit fresh 52-week highs defying 1,247-point Sensex slump
news.summary: Demonstrating acute relative strength against widespread market weakness, seven BSE 500 stocks touched fresh 52-week highs on September 24, led by Allied Blenders (up 17% in a month) and Carborundum Universal (up 15% in a month to ₹1,369), highlighting strong sector decoupling.
news.impact: Classic leading relative-strength behavior on down market days; these resilient names warrant high priority on swing watchlists for follow-through breakout entries.

news.headline: SEBI overhauls PMS norms to ease compliance and permit investments in foreign assets and ETFs
news.summary: Capital markets regulator SEBI unveiled a revised framework for Portfolio Management Services (PMS), allowing portfolio managers to take ETF exposures up to 1.25 times client AUM, relax certain onboarding processes, and invest in select foreign securities.
news.impact: Medium-term liquidity positive for asset managers and institutional ETF volumes, aiding long-term absorption during market pullbacks.

news.headline: Reliance Industries eyes ₹10,000 crore 10-year bond sale at 7.90% coupon ahead of RBI MPC
news.summary: Reliance Industries is preparing to raise approximately ₹10,000 crore ($1.04 billion) via 10-year rupee-denominated bonds at a coupon of 7.90%. Merchant bankers report RIL aims to tap bidding next week ahead of the RBI Monetary Policy Committee meeting scheduled for October 7.
news.impact: Locks in long-term liquidity at competitive domestic rates, reducing reliance on dollar debt while stock tests key support near quarterly base lows.

news.headline: Trent enters trading window closure from September 24; shares slip 2.75% in market correction
news.summary: Trent notified the exchanges that its trading window for insiders will be closed effective September 24, 2026, ahead of the upcoming Q2 FY27 earnings board meeting. The stock dropped 2.75% during Thursday's broad sell-off, despite recently reaching a milestone of 1,000 Zudio stores.
news.impact: Window closure limits insider activity as price tests the lower boundary of its multi-week trading range around ₹2,750.
